overview.description: The Innovator Growth Accelerated Plus ETF - April (QTAP) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ-100 index. The fund aims for 3x the price return of Invesco QQQ Trust ETF (QQQ), subject to an upside return cap over a specific holdings period. QTAP was launched on Apr 1, 2021 and is issued by Innovator.
